reason: I won't put an inline proxy from a startup with no customers and no SOC 2 report in front of our order path, even for free. If it goes down or gets breached, our trades stop and I'm the one explaining it to FINRA.
objection: A vendor with no SOC 2 and no references sitting between our customers' agents and order execution. Vendor risk won't approve it, and 'audit planned' means nothing to an examiner.
would_change_my_mind: A FINRA examiner asking us how we control and evidence AI agent trading, and we can't answer. That plus a finished SOC 2 Type II report would get it onto my desk.
